game_title: Name Tag Match – Village Green Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing torches before they reach rogue knights.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing torches before they reach rogue knights. Each round, a new torches challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of torches by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Village Green'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Village Green.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
